measurement_validity: BrowserGym-core 0.14.3 pinned with corrected AgentLab release: primary agentlab 0.4.2, fallback 0.3.0 if 0.4.2 incompatible (record which installed via pip freeze hash, neither 0.14.3). Compare vs B-RAG-EMBED-FLAT (flat retrieval without DOM-hash) and B-SPIDER-0TOKEN (verbatim replay) on same tasks: report false_accept (cache HIT when postcondition fails or DOM drift present) and UNKNOWN calibration if applicable. decision_rule: Frozen ordered evaluation; infrastructure precedence over scientific falsification; CAP/LFS exhaustive search ABANDONED per Director SUPERSEDE (not attempted). H1_AX_CONSISTENCY primary: If <5 families captured (or <10 valid AX trees 600-2000 nodes) after 3 Docker retries + Playwright install verification then result.status=COMPLETE outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE with H1=MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_unavailable (publish ax_captures failure reasons). Else if mean AX_consistency >=0.6 AND bootstrap CI lower >0.5 AND permutation p<0.05 vs NC1 shuffle null AND delta vs prior invalid 0.2857 >=0.20 AND PC1 liveness >=15/20 then H1=SURVIVES (parameterized same-mechanism transfer identifiable within-store at longest-prefix). Else if captured but mean <0.6 OR CI lower <=0.5 OR p>=0.05 then H1=FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for longest-prefix AX_consistency on WebArena v2 shopping (bounded to this method/families). H2_STAGEHAND replication: If <30/36 families attempted due to Docker unavailability then H2=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else if hit_rate reported with HIT on identical DOM >=0.8 AND MISS on drift >=0.8 AND false_accept <0.05 AND speedup and tokens_saved reported with provenance AND significantly beats NC4 random null (p<0.05) then H2=SURVIVES (Stagehand baseline replicable, competitive floor delivered). Else if executed but discrimination fails then H2=FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (Stagehand selector+hash not discriminating on this substrate). Overall experiment SURVIVES if H1 SURVIVES and H2 at least MEASUREMENT_VALID with reporting (H2 SURVIVES preferred but H1 alone suffices for AX claim per director). H3 relaxed Gate0 census is descriptive: report relaxed vs strict pass counts with CIs; no strict threshold gating but if >=1 relaxed passes it unblocks next physics relaxed pilot.
